name: goals
title: Goal tools
description: goal_set/goal_check for a trusted owner, thread and run. Host table agevexGoals; one explicit goal up to 4000 characters per run. Core receipts deduplicate tool calls.
docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Merge goalTables from the installed schema snippet into convex/schema.ts. Pass internal.agevexTools.goalsState to createGoalTools and register on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. No schema is overwritten. See /docs/tools/goals.
